pages.text: 16-1040 MORTAL KOMBAT 3 COMPLETION KIT INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS PARTS Caution: Static Sensitive Components. Use Proper Static Control Procedures When Handling The PCB. Part Number Description Quantity A-18968-40039__| CPU/Sound Board assembly 03-8338-1 PCB Mounting Spacers- 1/4" 16-10040 Installation Instructions 16-40039-101 Operation Manual 31-2322 Instruction Card Decal co}aja|foo] 4106-01115-12 | Sheet Metal Screws #6 x 3/4 pl-hwh INSTALLATION Be Sure The Game Cabinet Is Turned Off And Unplugged Before Attempting Any Installation Procedure. Instruction Card 1) 2) 3) 4) 5) Open the coin door. The coin door and rear door keys are attached to a joystick. Next, open the control panel. The control panel is held in place by two latches (located inside the cabinet) which provide constant pressure on the strikes. To release the latches, reach through the coin door opening toward the right and left sides of the cabinet. Do not reach straight back through the coin door or you could damage the monitor control board. Lift the latch handle and unhook the wire fasteners. Grip the joysticks and carefully tilt the control panel back on its hinge. Remove the five hex-head screws and the black metal strip at the bottom of the CRT viewing glass. Carefully, slide the glass from the side grooves and lift it clear of the cabinet. Remove the "Coming !n April 95" notice from the CRT. Clean the CRT and the CRT viewing glass. Peel off the protective paper on the back of the instruction card. Press the card to the bottom center of the bezel. Do Not Attach The Instruction Card To The Bottom Of The Monitor. Replace the CRT viewing glass, the black metal strip, and the five hex-head screws. Close the control panel. Carefully lean the panel forward until it rests on the cabinet. Be careful not to let the control panel slam down onto the cabinet, or to pinch any wires. Always re-clasp the latches. CPU/Sound Board Assembly 1) 2) 3) 4) 5) 6) Open the rear door of the cabinet. Insert the eight spacers into the holes in the CPU/Sound board. Place the PC board inside the cabinet, against the left. Align the cables with the proper connectors. (Follow the diagram on the reverse side of this page.) Plug the cables into the connectors and allow the board to hang by the cables. Attach the PC board to the inside left wall of the cabinet using the sheet metal screws provided. Be sure to leave some slack in the cables. Cables should not need to be stretched to reach the PC board. Set the DIP switches to desired functions. See the game Operation Manual for DIP switch information. Plug in and switch on the game. Once proper operation is ensured, replace the rear door and close the coin door.
